js: 'A toast that stays (a failed download, an error) never covers the Chat composer: the toast stack stands above it (--toast-bottom, the composer height), the toast host passes clicks through outside its pills, and a real click on the message field lands in it. Checked wide and narrow (the drawer layout). Read-only apart from typing into the box (never sent). Run: scripts/ui-drive.py scripts/drive/chat-toast.json --block-writes --token-file <dir>.token --base http://<addr>.'

(() => { window.__fail = n => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('lmgw-download-failed', { detail: { error: 'the drive keeps this toast up ' + i } })); return n; }; window.__geo = () => { const c = document.querySelector('.composer').getBoundingClientRect(); const ts = [...document.querySelectorAll('.toast-host .toast')].map(t => t.getBoundingClientRect()); const h = document.querySelector('.toast-host'); return { n: ts.length, hit: ts.some(t => t.left < c.right && t.right > c.left && t.top < c.bottom && t.bottom > c.top), bottom: Math.max(0, ...ts.map(t => t.bottom)), ctop: c.top, hostPe: getComputedStyle(h).pointerEvents, reserve: document.documentElement.style.getPropertyValue('--toast-bottom') }; }; return 'helpers'; })()

label: three toasts up: their geometry against the composer

expect: (() => { const g = __geo(); return g.n === 3 && !g.hit && g.bottom <= g.ctop && g.hostPe === 'none' && /px$/.test(g.reserve); })()
label: wide: three persistent toasts stand above the composer, the host passes clicks through, the composer's reserve is published
